usage: 太空人 is used as a noun to refer to a person who travels or works in outer space, commonly known in English as an astronaut.
When talking about 太空人, it is common to use it as the subject or object in sentences such as 'The astronaut is training' or 'I want to become an astronaut.'
太空人 can appear in singular or plural contexts, for example, 'This 太空人 is brave' or '太空人 工作喺太空度', meaning astronauts work in space.
The word 太空人 can be combined with verbs related to space activities, like '探險' (to explore) or '飛行' (to fly), to describe what astronauts do.
In questions, 太空人 can be used to ask about someone's profession or interests, for instance, '你想唔想做太空人？' meaning 'Do you want to be an astronaut?'
